name: ARTEMIS
description: Converts natural-language instructions into reliable Android device automation for coding agents, capturing logs and screenshots from each run.

skills.name: Instruction Execution
skills.description: Executes a natural-language instruction against a connected Android device or emulator.

skills.name: UI Inspection
skills.description: Reads the on-screen view hierarchy so an agent can decide what to tap or type next.

skills.name: Run Capture
skills.description: Captures logs, screenshots, and step traces from an automation run for later debugging.
